relationships.subject: Trichostatin A
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with TSA significantly enhanced visceral hypersensitivity at 3 h and 6 h in ELS rats

relationships.subject: C646
relationships.evidence_quote: the microinjection of C646 in the CeA attenuated visceral hypersensitivity of ELS rats when compared with control rats

relationships.subject: ZIP
relationships.evidence_quote: The administration of PKMζ inhibitor ZIP into the CeA attenuated visceral hypersensitivity of ELS rats

relationships.subject: Trichostatin A
relationships.evidence_quote: TSA treatment increased amygdala PKMζ expression in control rats

relationships.subject: early life stress
relationships.evidence_quote: Amygdala nucleus HDAC1 and HDAC2 expressions decreased, whereas HDAC3 expression had no significant difference between ELS rats and control rats

key_findings: Early life stress rats had increased amygdala acH3K9 and PKMzeta with decreased HDAC1/HDAC2 (not HDAC3).
CeA HDAC inhibition by TSA enhanced visceral hypersensitivity and raised PKMzeta; HAT inhibitor C646 and ZIP attenuated it.
